components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for the current work surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--background)); padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-button-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A familiar inline command that does not compete with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard compact editor and settings input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font: 500 12px/16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 38px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current desktop destination with explicit current-page state.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--background)); padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Compact metadata, never a replacement for ordinary labels.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--muted)); color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 12px/16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Framed Tool Panel
components.description: A genuinely framed editor, preview, dialog, or repeated item.

components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground)); padding: 16px; } .ds-panel strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font: 400 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Preference Switch
components.description: A stable binary preference control with explicit accessible state.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); padding: 2px; } .ds-switch span { display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--background)); transform: translateX(20px); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-switch span { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
PromptHub is a compact, rigorous, tool-like workspace. It should feel ready for real work immediately: dense enough for repeated editing and comparison, calm enough for long sessions, and precise enough that users trust every saved state. Its visual authority comes from hierarchy, alignment, and predictable feedback.

The workbench supports two named theme families. Catppuccin retains its official Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha character; Claude provides a warmer light and dark alternative. Theme personality changes, but semantic component roles and interaction behavior do not.

PromptHub explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard: no oversized card grids, gradients, badge piles, decorative metrics, or marketing composition in operational screens.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, precise controls with stable dimensions.
One restrained signal accent for action, selection, and focus.
Consistent desktop navigation and form vocabulary.
Fast state transitions with no decorative choreography.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue should occupy no more than the interactive emphasis needed on a screen. If inactive surfaces turn blue, the signal has lost its meaning.

rules.name: The Family and Mode Rule
rules.body: Theme family and light/dark/system mode are independent. An OS mode change may swap a variant; it must never change the stored family, accent, or Catppuccin dark variant.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Never assume white is valid on every primary color. Use the paired on-primary token and verify WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.

rules.name: The One Working Voice Rule
rules.body: Use one interface family across product UI. Never introduce a second display family merely to make a settings heading feel special.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: A resting card or section must not use a wide shadow. If a one-pixel border and a shadow are both decorative, remove the shadow.

dos: Do use semantic tokens so Catppuccin and Claude remain behaviorally identical even when their palettes differ.
Do keep primary actions, selection, and focus on Signal Blue and use the correct on-primary contrast partner.
Do use 10px control radii, 12px panel radii, and the 4/8/12/16/24px spacing rhythm consistently.
Do constrain long settings and editor copy to readable line lengths while allowing lists and data surfaces to remain dense.
Do expose hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, and selected states, with status never conveyed by color alone.
Do keep state motion between 150-200ms and provide an immediate reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't resemble a generic SaaS dashboard: no oversized cards, gradients, badge-heavy layouts, decorative metrics, or marketing composition in the app.
Don't nest cards or turn full-width page sections into floating cards.
Don't pair a decorative one-pixel border with a wide shadow; resting surfaces use tone and dividers.
Don't use display fonts, gradient text, glassmorphism, decorative grids, or giant rounded containers to manufacture personality.
Don't hide common commands behind modals or unfamiliar controls when a standard inline product pattern exists.
Don't use white text on dark-theme Signal Blue; use `colors.on-primary-dark` so the control remains readable.
